questions.question: It's the first week of the semester. You'd rather...

choices.choice: Join a group project chat and start throwing out ideas
Read through the syllabus twice before saying anything

questions.question: You just solved a tricky bug in your code. What now?

choices.choice: Tell everyone in the group chat immediately
Quietly commit it and move on to the next problem

questions.question: During a group hackathon, you naturally gravitate toward...

choices.choice: Rallying the team and talking through ideas out loud
Diving straight into your own laptop to prototype quietly

questions.question: Given a messy dataset, your first instinct is to...

choices.choice: Check column types, nulls, and ranges row by row
Picture the whole pipeline and where this fits in it

questions.question: In a lecture on a new model architecture, you're most drawn to...

choices.choice: The exact formulas and implementation details
The bigger idea it borrows from and where else it could apply

questions.question: When learning a new Python library, you first...

choices.choice: Read the documentation start to finish, testing each function as you go
Skim a few examples to grasp the overall idea, then improvise from there

questions.question: Your teammate's approach to the project is inefficient. You...

choices.choice: Point out the flaw directly so it gets fixed
Ease into it, framing it as a suggestion

questions.question: When picking a project topic for the team, you weigh...

choices.choice: Which idea is technically the most interesting
Which idea the whole team will enjoy working on

questions.question: A groupmate submits work with a flawed methodology days before the deadline. You...

choices.choice: Flag the error directly and explain the correct approach
Consider how stressed they must be and find a gentle way to bring it up

questions.question: Two weeks before a deadline, your notebook looks like....

choices.choice: A clear plan with milestones already checked off
A dozen open tabs and experiments in progress

questions.question: Your ideal way to explore a new dataset is to...

choices.choice: Follow a structured EDA checklist top to bottom
Poke around wherever looks interesting first

questions.question: The night before a paper's deadline, you're...

choices.choice: Already done, just proofreading
Still restructuring the whole outline because a better idea just hit you
